This is disclosed in the fidelity gaps. No Limit is declared and no operator-required bound is needed. Warnings accepted: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (the bridge stores the seed for the next reset and makes no environment call); G7.MAYBE_ABSENT x5 for action_space, observation_space, reset, step and close (they come from the external DirectRLEnv/Gymnasium base, which the clone's AST cannot follow); four G8.NO_UNIT for the bridge-derived ticks, action.values and seed inputs. No G4.REF_VALUE or G4.REF_BINARY warning was emitted. Only catalogue classes cap.world.step.v1, cap.world.reset.v1 and cap.world.seed.v1 are bound; there are no extension ids and no catalogue_requests.
